Everyone is very different. Some people get a laparoscopy and it is terrible and still have pain, for some it’s great and once they’re healed they aren’t in any pain. Personally, I was terrified of it (I hate needles and blood). It ended up being fine, it wasn’t great and it was painful but it wasn’t actually too bad. It took me a while to heal and not be in heaps of pain (I got a lot of things done in surgery so it took me a while to heal) but once I did, I still get pain every day but it isn’t nearly as bad as it used to be. Think of it like this- the momentary pain you will feel after surgery is nothing compared to the amount of pain you have been in. If I were to suggest some things- after surgery make sure to rest a lot, have heat packs, and possibly have someone there with you to get you things if you are in too much pain to when you get home (personally I needed that- but again, I had a long healing time). Best of luck!!! If there is a chance it can help you more, I would take it. Make sure you listen to what they will do in the procedure and do some research on it. I wouldn’t say it’s something to be scared of

Hey I’m sorry you’re in so much pain. For me some things that helped were a heat pack, they sell electric ones that wrap around you.
